page.overview:
What is Shista?

Shista, God of Fidelity, is a Great Old One created by the late American author R. H. Barlow for his short story "The Fidelity of Ghu".

A shape-shifting, hermaphroditic Great Old One that mainly manifests as a spiny five-legged crab, Shista possesses a spider-like head and wears metallic bracelets on each limb.
